explication: Gemini Balance is a FastAPI proxy and load balancer for Gemini, with Gemini and OpenAI-compatible interfaces. The main path is a client request through routing and authentication, key selection, chat/embedding/image services, and an upstream API call; administration and monitoring provide parallel workflows. README capability statements cover features whose route or implementation details were not sampled. Edges below are limited to relationships explicit in excerpts, the SOURCE INDEX, or README; unsampled subsystems have no speculative wiring.
